question: Should host-read capability accept full-buffer-validated `text/vcard` files by default?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and covers the known spoofing path, but the decision to broaden which local files an agent may send is a repository security-policy choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept validated vCards by default
options.body: Merge the current guarded implementation so normal `.vcf` contact files can be sent while binary-tailed text payloads remain rejected.

options.title: Keep the existing boundary closed
options.body: Do not add `text/vcard` to the default allowlist if host-read document scope should remain limited to the current MIME set.

recommendation.title: Accept validated vCards by default
recommendation.body: Merge the current guarded implementation so normal `.vcf` contact files can be sent while binary-tailed text payloads remain rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent MIME-precedence surface and is the strongest available routing signal for the default allowlist decision.
